category_title: Six-year-old girl with PDD-NOS exhibiting behavioral obsessions and communication delays
scenario_title: Managing object of obsession during matching task
minimal_context: The student is sitting at a desk during a teaching session, tasked with matching nonidentical 3-D objects to 2-D pictures.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is a toy cup and a picture of a different cup. Put them together to match.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits sideways in her chair, not facing the teacher. She holds the book 'Lemon Girl' and shakes it in her hands.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please turn around and look at the materials.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Faces away from the materials, gets up from the desk, and throws the picture card on the floor.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to do our work now. Give me the book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Cries and shouts loudly, hitting the teacher's hand to stop them from taking the book. She holds onto it tightly, refusing to leave it.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is a toy cup and a picture of a different cup. Put them together to match.

STUDENT: (Sits sideways in her chair, not facing the teacher. She holds the book 'Lemon Girl' and shakes it in her hands.)

TUTOR: Please turn around and look at the materials.

STUDENT: (Faces away from the materials, gets up from the desk, and throws the picture card on the floor.)

TUTOR: We need to do our work now. Give me the book.

STUDENT: (Cries and shouts loudly, hitting the teacher's hand to stop them from taking the book. She holds onto it tightly, refusing to leave it.)

task.content: match nonidentical three-dimensional (3-D) and two- dimensional (2-D) objects of the same dimension and sorting

context.materials: course materials, the book named 'Lemon Girl'

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when an attempt is made to take it [the book named 'Lemon Girl']
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: displays problem behaviors such as crying and hitting, shaking it in her hands, crying, hitting and shouting

behavior_patterns.condition: when the student is paying attention to the object of obsession in her hand
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: not leaving it, shaking it in her hands
